# Authority to obtain the final account

I, ⟦PERSON|Ceryna MacKell⟧, appoint ⟦PERSON|Mireva Quennell⟧ to obtain the final account and the receipts relating to the stored display equipment. The attorney may request explanations and compare the account with the signed storage schedule. This authority does not permit borrowing or acceptance of a new storage tariff.

The attorney must distinguish an agreed charge from an amount that remains disputed. Recording receipt of an invoice does not establish that the invoice is payable. A proposed settlement of the disputed balance requires a further signed instruction identifying the amount and the claim affected.

Copies of the account may be delivered to ⟦ADDRESS|28 Alder Row, Hereford⟧. An unsigned request to redirect the originals to another destination must be checked with the donor. The maximum copying and delivery charge is GBP 55.

The appointment concerns the named attorney personally. Any professional assistance obtained in carrying out the inspection must remain within the permitted purpose. The private advisory firm identified in the acknowledgement is not substituted as attorney by that acknowledgement alone.

Donor's signature: ⟦PERSON|Ceryna MacKell⟧

Attorney's acceptance: ⟦PERSON|Mireva Quennell⟧ LLB

Administrative acknowledgement for and on behalf of ⟦ORG|Slate Purl Advice LLP⟧: ⟦PERSON|Orren Vannick⟧.

Executed on 6 February 2027. Paragraph 5.2 concerns the inspection record.
